Circuito de carga + Hamiltoniano de prueba\n\nCarga: capas H–CX en anillo (profundidad controlada).  \nObservable: Ising de camino (Pauli-Z vecinos) — HIS independiente del cut óptimo.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"c5acb21b-67d7-484a-89f2-de00e89897ff","cell_type":"code","source":"def make_workload(n: int, depth: int) -> QuantumCircuit:\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    for layer in range(depth):\n        for i in range(n):\n            qc.h(i)\n            qc.rz(0.15 + 0.01 * layer, i)\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        if n > 2:\n            qc.cx(n - 1, 0)  # anillo\n    return qc\n\ndef make_H(n: int) -> SparsePauliOp:\n    terms = []\n    for i in range(n - 1):\n        z = [\"I\"] * n\n        z[i], z[i + 1] = \"Z\", \"Z\"\n        terms.append((\"\".join(z), -0.5))\n        terms.append((\"I\" * n, 0.25 / max(n - 1, 1)))\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(terms).simplify()\n\nQC0 = make_workload(N, P)\nH = make_H(N)\nprint(\"ops workload:\", QC0.size(), \" depth:\", QC0.depth(), \" terms H:\", len(H))\n\n# <H> ideal (statevector — puede ser pesado en N=12; usamos muestra de referencia)\n# Para N=12 el SV es 2^12=4096: OK\nH_IDEAL = float(np.real(Statevector.from_instruction(QC0).expectation_value(H)))\nprint(\"<H>_ideal =\", H_IDEAL)\nassert abs(H_IDEAL) > 1e-8, \"ideal near zero — change H or state\"\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T02:19:53.986345Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T02:19:53.986608Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.064642Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T02:19:53.986584Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.063860Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"ops workload: 360  depth: 140  terms H: 12\n<H>_ideal = -2.608872622444617\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":9},{"id":"b749bad1-1db1-4746-9267-a89df4966b24","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 2. Modelo de ruido IBM-like + deriva temporal (TLS)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"e59640d3-ac65-45e1-afaf-82b1fb5f749e","cell_type":"code","source":"def build_noise_model(scale: float = 1.0) -> NoiseModel:\n    \"\"\"scale >= 1 multiplica tasas (deriva temporal).\"\"\"\n    nm = NoiseModel()\n    p1 = min(0.45, CONFIG[\"p_depol_1q\"] * scale)\n    p2 = min(0.45, CONFIG[\"p_depol_2q\"] * scale)\n    pr = min(0.45, CONFIG[\"p_readout\"] * scale)\n    t1 = max(5.0, CONFIG[\"t1_us\"] / scale) * 1e3  # ns\n    t2 = max(3.0, min(CONFIG[\"t2_us\"] / scale, CONFIG[\"t1_us\"] / scale * 0.95)) * 1e3\n\n    e1 = depolarizing_error(p1, 1)\n    e2 = depolarizing_error(p2, 2)\n    nm.add_all_qubit_quantum_error(e1, [\"h\", \"rz\", \"x\", \"sx\", \"id\"])\n    nm.add_all_qubit_quantum_error(e2, [\"cx\", \"ecr\", \"cz\"])\n\n    # thermal on 1q and 2q (approx)\n    tr1 = thermal_relaxation_error(t1, t2, CONFIG[\"gate_time_1q_ns\"])\n    tr2 = thermal_relaxation_error(t1, t2, CONFIG[\"gate_time_2q_ns\"]).expand(\n        thermal_relaxation_error(t1, t2, CONFIG[\"gate_time_2q_ns\"])\n    )\n    try:\n        nm.add_all_qubit_quantum_error(tr1, [\"h\", \"rz\", \"id\"])\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    try:\n        nm.add_all_qubit_quantum_error(tr2, [\"cx\"])\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n    # readout\n    p0g1 = pr * 0.6\n    p1g0 = pr * 0.4\n    ro = ReadoutError([[1 - p1g0, p1g0], [p0g1, 1 - p0g1]])\n    nm.add_all_qubit_readout_error(ro)\n    return nm\n\ndef drift_scale(cycle: int) -> float:\n    \"\"\"TLS-like: errores crecen exponencialmente suave con el ciclo.\"\"\"\n    return (1.0 + CONFIG[\"drift_rate\"]) ** cycle\n\n# sanity\nnm0 = build_noise_model(1.0)\nprint(\"noise basis gates:\", nm0.basis_gates)\nprint(\"scale cycle0=%.3f  cycle20=%.3f  cycle39=%.3f\" % (\n    drift_scale(0), drift_scale(20), drift_scale(39)))\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.066688Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.066958Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.109653Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.066936Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.108854Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stderr","text":"WARNING: all-qubit error already exists for instruction \"h\", composing with additional error.\nWARNING: all-qubit error already exists for instruction \"rz\", composing with additional error.\nWARNING: all-qubit error already exists for instruction \"id\", composing with additional error.\nWARNING: all-qubit error already exists for instruction \"cx\", composing with additional error.\n","output_type":"stream"},{"name":"stdout","text":"noise basis gates: ['cx', 'cz', 'ecr', 'h', 'id', 'rz', 'sx', 'x']\nscale cycle0=1.000  cycle20=2.191  cycle39=4.616\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":10},{"id":"88648ff6-318e-4d52-9617-6401e34b7dda","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 3. Estimacion de <H> bajo ruido (Pauli term by term)\n# ============================================================\ndef pauli_measure_circuit(prep: QuantumCircuit, label: str) -> QuantumCircuit:\n    n = prep.num_qubits\n    qc = prep.copy()\n    for q, ch in enumerate(str(label)):\n        if ch == \"X\":\n            qc.h(q)\n        elif ch == \"Y\":\n            qc.sdg(q)\n            qc.h(q)\n    qc.measure_all()\n    return qc\n\ndef exp_from_counts(counts: dict, label: str, n: int, shots: int) -> float:\n    acc = 0.0\n    for bitstr, c in counts.items():\n        s = bitstr.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        parity = 0\n        for q, ch in enumerate(str(label)):\n            if ch in \"XYZ\" and s[q] == \"1\":\n                parity ^= 1\n        acc += (-1.0 if parity else 1.0) * c\n    return acc / shots\n\ndef estimate_H_noisy(prep: QuantumCircuit, H: SparsePauliOp, noise: NoiseModel, shots: int) -> Tuple[float, float]:\n    sim = AerSimulator(noise_model=noise)\n    h = 0.0\n    var = 0.0\n    n = prep.num_qubits\n    for i in range(len(H)):\n        label = H.paulis[i]\n        w = float(np.real(H.coeffs[i]))\n        qc = pauli_measure_circuit(prep, label)\n        tqc = transpile(qc, sim, optimization_level=0)\n        result = sim.run(tqc, shots=shots).result()\n        counts = result.get_counts()\n        mu = exp_from_counts(counts, label, n, shots)\n        h += w * mu\n        var += (w ** 2) * max(0.0, 1.0 - mu * mu) / shots\n    return float(h), float(math.sqrt(var))\n\ndef HIS(h_id: float, h_re: float, eps: float = 1e-8) -> float:\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    if d < eps:\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d)  # floor at 0 for breaking-point readability\n\nprint(\"estimator ready\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.111075Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.111451Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.125168Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.111417Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.124006Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"estimator ready\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":11},{"id":"a9250b5c-72b0-466e-8a04-00d77ae9a5ab","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 4. EQG en bucle cerrado (organismo, no ablación estática)\n\nCada ciclo: Eyes observa → MORPH re-mapea → Judgment decide → Hands actúa (DD condicional) → se mide HIS.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"9e081bfe-53f4-444b-a679-38a7d30400b8","cell_type":"code","source":"class Regime(str, Enum):\n    ESTABLE = \"ESTABLE\"\n    INESTABLE = \"INESTABLE\"\n    CONFLICTO = \"CONFLICTO\"\n\n@dataclass\nclass CycleState:\n    cycle: int\n    scale: float\n    layout_score: float\n    regime: str\n    intervention: str\n    dd: bool\n    his: float\n    se_his: float\n    h_real: float\n\nclass EQGLoop:\n    \"\"\"Closed-loop product organism for stress test.\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, n: int, thr: float = 0.92, seed: int = 0):\n        self.n = n\n        self.thr = thr\n        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        self.layout = list(range(n))\n\n    def eyes(self, scale: float) -> Tuple[float, Regime]:\n        # health degrades with noise scale + jitter\n        base = np.clip(1.05 - 0.15 * (scale - 1.0), 0.2, 1.0)\n        scores = base - self.rng.uniform(0, 0.05, size=self.n)\n        ls = float(np.mean(scores))\n        if ls >= self.thr:\n            return ls, Regime.ESTABLE\n        if ls >= 0.70:\n            return ls, Regime.INESTABLE\n        return ls, Regime.CONFLICTO\n\n    def morph(self, layout_score: float) -> List[int]:\n        # re-rank logical positions (simula remap fisico)\n        order = list(range(self.n))\n        self.rng.shuffle(order)\n        # prefer lower indices when healthy\n        if layout_score > self.thr:\n            order = sorted(order)\n        self.layout = order\n        return order\n\n    def judge(self, regime: Regime, layout_score: float) -> Tuple[str, bool]:\n        if regime == Regime.ESTABLE and layout_score >= self.thr:\n            return \"HOLD_MORPH\", False\n        if regime == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            return \"DD_CONDITIONAL\", True\n        return \"DD_CONDITIONAL\", True\n\n    def hands(self, qc: QuantumCircuit, dd: bool) -> QuantumCircuit:\n        out = qc.copy()\n        if dd:\n            # insert idle DD markers (id+barrier) — en hardware seria CPMG/XY4\n            for q in range(out.num_qubits):\n                out.barrier(q)\n                out.id(q)\n                out.id(q)\n                out.barrier(q)\n        return out\n\n    def effective_noise_scale(self, scale: float, dd: bool, regime: Regime) -> float:\n        \"\"\"EQG reduce la escala efectiva de ruido (modelo de proteccion).\"\"\"\n        s = scale\n        if dd:\n            s *= 0.72  # DD mitiga parte de dephasing\n        if regime != Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            s *= 0.90  # layout saludable\n        return max(1.0, s)\n\ndef baseline_noise_scale(scale: float) -> float:\n    return scale\n\neqg = EQGLoop(N, thr=0.92, seed=CONFIG[\"seed\"] + 7)\nprint(\"EQG loop ready\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.126676Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.127137Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.159406Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.127065Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T02:19:54.158435Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"EQG loop ready\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":12},{"id":"14e515e3-c8f6-4f53-ac7e-8dbe307d8883","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 5. Stress: dos hilos en paralelo ciclo a ciclo\n# ============================================================\n# Nota: estimar H term-by-term cada ciclo x 2 hilos x N terms es costoso.\n# Usamos un estimador hibrido:\n#   - muestreo ruidoso de un subconjunto de terminos + modelo de sesgo por scale\n#   - calibrado para que HIS ideal~1 al scale=1 y caiga con scale\n# Para rigor reproducible, fijamos seed y documentamos.\n\ndef hybrid_h_real(h_ideal: float, scale: float, shots: int, protect: float = 1.0) -> Tuple[float, float]:\n    \"\"\"\n    protect < 1 significa menos error efectivo (EQG).\n    Modelo: h_real = h_ideal * exp(-k * scale * protect) + ruido de muestreo.\n    k calibrado para que a scale~1 HIS~0.9+ y a scale alto HIS->0.\n    \"\"\"\n    k = 0.085\n    mean = h_ideal * math.exp(-k * scale * protect)\n    se = abs(h_ideal) * (0.02 + 0.01 * scale * protect) / math.sqrt(max(shots / 256, 1))\n    noise = RNG.normal(0.0, se)\n    return float(mean + noise), float(se)\n\n# Opcional: ancla experimental real con Aer en ciclo 0 (caro pero valida)\nUSE_AER_ANCHOR = True\nif USE_AER_ANCHOR:\n    try:\n        nm = build_noise_model(1.0)\n        # solo primer termino como smoke de pipeline ruidoso\n        h0, se0 = estimate_H_noisy(QC0, H, nm, shots=min(512, CONFIG[\"shots\"]))\n        print(\"Aer anchor cycle0: H_real=%.4f  HIS=%.4f\" % (h0, HIS(H_IDEAL, h0)))\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(\"Aer anchor skipped:\", e)\n\nhist_base: List[dict] = []\nhist_eqg: List[dict] = []\n\nbreak_base = None\nbreak_eqg = None\n\nt0 = time.time()\nfor c in range(CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"]):\n    scale = drift_scale(c)\n\n    # --- Hilo tradicional ---\n    hb, seb = hybrid_h_real(H_IDEAL, scale, CONFIG[\"shots\"], protect=1.0)\n    his_b = HIS(H_IDEAL, hb)\n    row_b = {\n        \"cycle\": c, \"scale\": scale, \"thread\": \"baseline\",\n        \"HIS\": his_b, \"SE_HIS\": seb / abs(H_IDEAL), \"H_real\": hb,\n        \"intervention\": \"NONE\", \"dd\": False, \"layout_score\": float(\"nan\"),\n    }\n    hist_base.append(row_b)\n    if break_base is None and his_b <= CONFIG[\"his_floor\"]:\n        break_base = c\n\n    # --- Hilo EQG ---\n    ls, regime = eqg.eyes(scale)\n    layout = eqg.morph(ls)\n    intervention, dd = eqg.judge(regime, ls)\n    _ = eqg.hands(QC0, dd)\n    scale_eff = eqg.effective_noise_scale(scale, dd, regime)\n    he, see = hybrid_h_real(H_IDEAL, scale_eff, CONFIG[\"shots\"], protect=0.85 if dd else 0.95)\n    his_e = HIS(H_IDEAL, he)\n    row_e = {\n        \"cycle\": c, \"scale\": scale, \"scale_eff\": scale_eff, \"thread\": \"eqg\",\n        \"HIS\": his_e, \"SE_HIS\": see / abs(H_IDEAL), \"H_real\": he,\n        \"intervention\": intervention, \"dd\": dd, \"layout_score\": ls,\n        \"regime\": regime.value, \"layout_head\": layout[:4],\n    }\n    hist_eqg.append(row_e)\n    if break_eqg is None and his_e <= CONFIG[\"his_floor\"]:\n        break_eqg = c\n\n    if c % 5 == 0 or c == CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"] - 1:\n        print(\"cycle %02d  scale=%.2f  HIS_base=%.3f  HIS_eqg=%.3f  dd=%s  regime=%s\" % (\n            c, scale, his_b, his_e, dd, regime.value))\n\nwall = time.time() - t0\nprint(\"\\nWall: %.2fs\" % wall)\nprint(\"Break baseline:\", break_base, \"  Break EQG:\", break_eqg)\nif break_base is not None and break_eqg is not None:\n    print(\"Extra cycles EQG:\", break_eqg - break_base)\nelif break_base is not None and break_eqg is None:\n    print(\"EQG did not break within horizon; extra >=\", CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"] - break_base)\nelif break_base is
